verdict.rationale: Decagon is a commercial AI customer-support platform, and an open-source license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows source code published under an open license. The claim that technical teams have "full visibility and control over guardrails, integrations, and versioning" describes a product-control feature, not source availability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
